narrow_authorization.authorized_action: Read-only emission of one artifact, REM-001_IMPORT_GRAPH.json (Gate 1 deliverable 3 of 9), from the existing already-tested generator tools/build_architecture_inventory.py, together with the smallest additive code change required to make that generator emit the graph it already computes.
narrow_authorization.basis_for_narrowness: The generator's AST import-resolution logic already traverses this exact graph twice and discards it both times: compute_runtime_closure walks resolved import edges and returns only the visited module list, and find_forbidden_edges materialises importer/imported pairs and retains only the violations. condition_detail.no_classification_judgment: The emitted graph carries no source_scope, domain, owner, lifecycle, criticality or responsibility field. Those require the human review gate ARCH-001.2.1 reserves, and asserting them here would convert UNKNOWN into inferred truth.
condition_detail.regression_gate: Breadth-first traversal from the declared entry points over the emitted edge set must reproduce exactly the module set checked in at packaging/atlas_runtime_closure.json. A divergence invalidates the emission.

explicit_non_grants.note: This authorization does not set, imply, or create a basis for setting any of the following true, in any general sense or for any other purpose.

why_this_deliverable_specifically: It is the only one of the nine Gate 1 deliverables with no dependency on the other eight.
Its entire input is already computed by tracked, tested tooling, so it requires no new analysis and no new trust in an unvalidated tool.
It is a pure function of the current Git tree and is stamped with its own commit, so it does not depend on resolving ARCH-P0-001.
It requires no human classification judgment, so it cannot encode an inferred truth.
It is mechanically falsifiable against an artifact that already exists.
narrow_authorization.deliverable_state_note: This registry grants the authorization prospectively and is committed before the emission occurs, so it records no measured evidence for the artifact. The produced artifact, its generation commit, its counts and its regression-gate result require a further versioned successor registry. Until that registry exists, no evidence claim about the emitted artifact is carried by this one.
narrow_authorization.gate_1_progress_effect: NONE. Producing one deliverable does not advance gate_1_state, which remains OPEN_NOT_CERTIFIED, and does not constitute partial gate closure.

generation.analysis_rules_note: compute_import_graph reuses _tracked_python_files, _build_module_index, _resolve_imports and _ancestor_package_files unchanged, satisfying authorization condition NO_NEW_ANALYSIS_SEMANTICS_EMISSION_ONLY.

artifact_statistics.edge_count_note: edges_total counts (from, to, kind) triples; 11 pairs carry both kinds. edges_distinct_module_pairs is the figure to use when counting dependencies between modules.

edge_kinds.import: the importer references the target module directly
edge_kinds.package_init: the importer references a submodule, so Python executes the ancestor package's __init__.py. The runtime-closure BFS follows these, so omitting them would make the graph unable to reproduce the closure.

artifact_statistics.parse_failure_note: Retained per the ARCH-001.2.1 invariant that parse failures are not silently dropped. None is in the runtime closure, so none holes the graph or affects the regression gate. Their edges are absent.

regression_gate.output: OK: BFS over emitted edges reproduces packaging/atlas_runtime_closure.json exactly (105 modules)
regression_gate.method_note: compute_import_graph does not call compute_runtime_closure and does not share its BFS. The two functions compose the same resolution primitives independently, so agreement is a real comparison rather than a tautology. Had the emission dropped the package_init edge kind, the gate would have failed by under-reaching.
regression_gate.determinism_method: Two consecutive --write runs produced byte-identical output (sha256 d59dd520b9414ee10918f2af11375807a25994a4ad28b6a52352a1a416722eee, measured before the edges_distinct_module_pairs addition).

validation_evidence.environment_note: Whether this satisfies the ENV-ISOLATION-001 canonical isolated virtual-environment requirement was not established and is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than inferred, exactly as registries v4.28, v4.29 recorded the same question for their own baselines.
validation_evidence.independent_audit_note: CLAUDE.md's critical-task final gate names an independent audit. Self-review and regression testing were performed; independent audit was not. Recorded rather than implied as satisfied.

conformance_to_specification.reason: REM-001 names the filename REM-001_IMPORT_GRAPH.json but no content schema, and the specification that would have defined one is among the artifacts GOV-DRIFT-005 records as absent. The produced artifact therefore satisfies the declared NAME. Whether it satisfies what the absent specification intended cannot be assessed and is not inferred.
conformance_to_specification.what_is_asserted: The artifact is internally consistent, deterministic, self-describing by commit, carries no classification judgment, and passes the regression gate registry v4.30 attached to its authorization.
conformance_to_specification.what_is_not_asserted: That it is the artifact REM-001's authors intended, that its schema is the intended schema, or that it would satisfy the absent REM-001_GATE1_VALIDATOR.ps1.

rem001_gate1_deliverable_3_production.classification_judgment_note: Authorization condition 3 satisfied. The artifact deliberately omits source_scope, domain, owner, current_responsibility, intended_responsibility, state_ownership, lifecycle and criticality, and lists them as deliberately absent. ARCH-001.2.1 reserves those for a human review gate where scanner evidence may propose but never approve; emitting them would convert UNKNOWN into inferred truth. They belong to Gate 1 deliverable 1.

gate_1_effect.note: Producing one of nine deliverables does not advance gate_1_state, does not constitute partial gate closure, and does not create any expectation that the remaining eight are authorized. Each would require its own owner decision.
gate_1_effect.deliverable_8_remains_independently_bloc: REM-001_SPECIFICATION_RECONCILIATION_MATRIX.md reconciles intended against actual responsibility. Its intended-responsibility source is among the absent artifacts, so it has no left-hand side and is blocked independently of the other seven.

absent_artifact_census_update.note: One of the 42 declared filenames is now occupied by a produced artifact. GOV-DRIFT-005 remains OPEN: the finding is about the absent REM-001 specification and the 41 artifacts still missing, and producing a file that carries a declared name does not restore the specification that would define its content.

findings_explicitly_left_open.note: Carried forward from registry v4.30 unchanged. Both remain open with owner decisions pending and are neither addressed nor closed by this registry. Their statement of record is rem001_specification_artifact_integrity.findings_explicitly_left_open, which this registry preserves byte-identical.

ARCH-P0-001.title: Baseline identity conflict
ARCH-P0-001.relationship_to_this_deliverable: The deliverable was chosen partly because it does not depend on the answer: the artifact is a pure function of the tree it names and stamps its own commit, so it describes that tree rather than a baseline someone must first agree on. Producing it neither resolves the conflict nor selects a canonical baseline.

GATE-1-AUTHORIZATION-CONTRADICTION.title: Gate 1 is open and named as next work while every execution path for it is unauthorized
GATE-1-AUTHORIZATION-CONTRADICTION.relationship_to_this_deliverable: v4.30 granted one explicit narrow exception for this single artifact. That exception is now spent. The general contradiction is unchanged, and every flag it names remains false.

scope_additions_recorded.note: Recorded rather than left silent. Both went slightly beyond a bare emit and both are additive.

test_file.justification: CLAUDE.md rule 8, and ARCH-INVENTORY-001 recorded in registry v4.29 demonstrated that a generated artifact going stale is caught only when tests enforce it.
test_file.deliberate_limitation: The tests exercise the pure computation, never write the artifact, and deliberately do NOT assert that the checked-in artifact is current. Keeping it fresh is not an obligation the narrow authorization created, and imposing one would exceed it.

edge_count_clarification.reason: 11 pairs legitimately carry both edge kinds, so a consumer reading edges_total as a dependency count would over-count. edges_distinct_module_pairs was added with a note naming which figure to use.
